name: one-commit-per-mutation
body:
One logical mutation → one commit. Every `apg node` / `apg edge` mutation keeps its atomic write-and-commit envelope: the mutation's durable write (its node/edge files) and its commit land as a single unit, and successive mutations each commit once. Batching commits across mutations is not permitted unless a deliberate decision changes this contract.

This law governs commits only. It says nothing that permits deferring or batching projection visibility: the projection delta is applied synchronously with the mutation and is never deferred, per `global.constraint.immediate-queryability`.
